artifacts.title: Command (action control)
artifacts.summary: Square action control; primary (solid accent), secondary (ink border), destructive (accent border, reserved for high-consequence actions).

a11y: Real <button> semantics; visible label is the accessible name; focus ring required (authored, no source basis).
Destructive variant must not be the default action in a form.

source.path: p8 color-use rules; p45 signage principles

artifacts.title: Entry (text field)
artifacts.summary: Single-line text input: label above, 1px ink border, error line below in accent; square.

a11y: <label for> association always; error text linked via aria-describedby (authored).
Error copy is one concise sentence naming the problem.

source.path: p30 typographic style; p45-46 message clarity

artifacts.title: Chooser (small-set select)
artifacts.summary: Labelled native select for small fixed sets (about 12 options or fewer); larger or filtered selection is out of scope by design.

a11y: Native semantics; visible label; never replace with a custom listbox for small sets.

source.path: form language inferred from p41-44 formats (authored limit rule)

artifacts.title: Panel (bordered technical region)
artifacts.summary: 1px ink bordered region reserved for technical or diagrammatic content; ordinary prose uses sections and rules instead.

a11y: Titles are real headings; do not use panels nested more than one level deep.

artifacts.title: Band (identity, navigation, status)
artifacts.summary: Full-width white band with a 1px ink bottom rule: identity left, navigation (current item = 2px accent underline), environment/status text right; inverted variant uses ink background with white text.

a11y: Navigation is a <nav> list; current item marked with aria-current plus the underline.

source.path: p41 white band for folios/headlines; p8/p47 inversions

artifacts.title: Register (ruled data list)
artifacts.summary: Data list or table: header row in Medium, rows separated by 1px gray hairlines, top-aligned cells, row actions right as text commands; no zebra striping, no elevation.

a11y: Real table semantics where tabular; top-aligned text; row action labels are specific verbs.

artifacts.title: Indicator (status marker)
artifacts.summary: Status shown as a 6x6 square marker plus text label; tones neutral (gray), ok (ink), alert (accent); text always readable alone.

a11y: Never color alone: the text label carries the status; marker is decorative for AT.

source.path: semantics authored; accent discipline from p8

artifacts.title: Tag (square micro-label)
artifacts.summary: Square 1px gray-bordered micro-label for classification and metadata; tags keep their own visual space and never compete with status.

a11y: Tag text is plain text; do not encode meaning only in tag color (no color coding defined).

artifacts.title: Gauge (determinate progress)
artifacts.summary: Square determinate progress bar: paper track with 1px gray border, ink fill (accent fill when attention needed), mandatory text readout 'n of m'; static updates, no animation.

a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max; the visible readout is the same words. Motion is undefined in this system (no transitions).

artifacts.title: Notice (inline feedback block)
artifacts.summary: Square inline message block: info (gray border), warning (ink border), alert (accent border + accent heading); one concise sentence of copy; top of its region.

a11y: Role per kind (status vs alert); copy names the object and what happens next.

artifacts.title: Section (grouping)
artifacts.summary: Form or content grouping: Medium heading, 1px ink rule, stacked entries; form column max-width 560px; top-aligned.

a11y: fieldset/legend semantics for form groups.

artifacts.title: Dialog (modal confirm or editor)
artifacts.summary: Square modal: 1px ink border, ink band header with title and Close, body, right-aligned footer commands; page overlay is ink at 40% opacity; state appears and disappears instantly (no motion).

a11y: Focus trapped; Escape closes; confirm copy names the object and the consequence in the sentence.

source.path: authored structure; overlay value from p47 40% rule

artifacts.title: Application shell
artifacts.summary: Band on top, main region (max-width 1080, padding 24/32), footer folio line 'Orbit . section' in small gray type.

a11y: One <main> landmark; the band is <header>.

artifacts.title: Register view (list screen)
artifacts.summary: Shell plus page head (h1 and a primary command) plus register; empty state is a centered standby notice with one secondary command.

a11y: Empty state must be announced; standby copy says what to do next (one command).

artifacts.title: Form flow (create or edit)
artifacts.summary: Shell, sections of entries and choosers, validation notices above fields, footer row with a primary submit and a secondary cancel; destructive actions route through a dialog naming the object and consequence.

a11y: Validation summary notice is announced; destructive confirm is keyboard reachable.

artifacts.title: Job view (status console)
artifacts.summary: Shell plus indicator plus gauge plus a log register (time and message rows); status is always text plus marker; no animation anywhere.

a11y: State changes announced politely (aria-live on the status line); gauge readout text matches aria-valuetext.

artifacts.title: Orbit palette
artifacts.summary: Paper (white), ink (near-black), gray-mid (middle warm gray), accent (warm NASA-derived red), accent-ink (white). Accent is identification and action only, never a reading surface.

a11y: Contrast: ink on paper and accent-ink on accent meet 4.5:1 (to be verified by orbit-lint); accent text on paper allowed only at large sizes or bold weights.

source.path: p8-9 color standards and use rules

artifacts.title: Orbit type roles
artifacts.summary: Helvetica-register sans only in controls; scale 24/18/15/13/12; flush-left ragged-right; normal letterspacing; line-height 1.4; serif voice reserved for long-form content.

a11y: Body text at least 15px on screens; no justified text; never tighten letterspacing.

artifacts.title: Voice: clear and concise
artifacts.summary: UI copy is short, declarative, and names the object and the consequence; no ornament, no filler.

a11y: Error and confirm copy states what happened and what happens next in one sentence.

source.path: p45 'clear and concise'; p46 'Keep the signs simple'

artifacts.title: Accent discipline
artifacts.summary: The red accent marks identity and actions only; it never becomes a background behind reading text, never sits on mid-value surfaces, and is never the only signal.

a11y: Status never relies on accent color alone (see component/indicator).

artifacts.title: Source: NASA Graphics Standards Manual (NHB 1430.2, 1976)
artifacts.summary: Public-domain source document (US Government work) from which this system was derived; full provenance and extraction log in docs/portability/01-source-audit.md.
